subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

He gave his last coins to the beggar and walked home smiling.

He is:
A) greedy
B) generous
C) angry

steps: He gave his money. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The mountain stood guard over the valley.

This is:
A) personification
B) a simile
C) a fact

steps: Mountain given a human role. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To understand a hard passage, a good reader should:
A) reread it
B) skip it
C) close the book

steps: Rereading builds understanding. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Though mocked, the old shepherd kept watch nightly. When the flood came, only his family was ready.

The theme is:
A) listen to warnings and be prepared
B) always follow the crowd
C) floods are rare
items.answer: A) listen to warnings and be prepared

steps: Preparation paid off. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) listen to warnings and be prepared

items.prompt:
Read.

'Hope is a lantern in the dark.'

This metaphor means hope:
A) is a real lamp
B) guides us through hard times
C) is useless
items.answer: B) guides us through hard times

solution.answer: B) guides us through hard times

items.prompt:
Read.

The team trained hard, lost the game, then shook hands and smiled.

The theme is best described as:
A) good sportsmanship
B) winning is everything
C) never play sports

steps: Grace in defeat. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The narrator says, 'I never trusted the new neighbor, and nothing he did could change my mind.'

What should a careful reader remember?
A) The neighbor is definitely bad
B) This is a biased first-person view that may be unfair
C) The narrator knows everyone's thoughts
items.answer: B) This is a biased first-person view that may be unfair

steps: First-person can be biased. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) This is a biased first-person view that may be unfair

items.prompt:
Read.

She planted the oak tree knowing she would never live to sit in its shade.

The theme is:
A) gardening is hard
B) selfless giving benefits the future
C) trees grow slowly
items.answer: B) selfless giving benefits the future

steps: Giving without reward. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) selfless giving benefits the future
